description: The Tonga Statistics Department releases its 2021 Census of Population and Housing results as downloadable Excel tables for the first time, in general and household series. The household series counts households for Tonga, each division, district and village. Housing tables give building type, construction material (wood, metal, concrete or brick, traditional) and tenure. Service tables give drinking water source, separating piped supply from household and community water tanks, cooking fuel, lighting source split between public power supply, solar and own generators, internet access by technology from ADSL and fibre to satellite and mobile, waste disposal and toilets. A disaster preparedness table counts households that keep food stocks, know the nearest evacuation centre and route, and know emergency contacts. Of 18,847 households nationally, 17,731 light their homes from the public power supply and 707 from solar. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX, no registration; constituency reports sit alongside. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: the next census is being prepared for 2026. Simulation uses: village-level solar, generator and water tank reliance and evacuation awareness for cyclone and tsunami response planning. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.

Household Characteristics workbook: H6 goods; H7 drinking water source (piped supply, own tank, neighbour or community tank, bottled, boiled); H8 cooking fuel (electricity, LPG, biogas, kerosene, solar, wood and coconut husks); H9 lighting (public power supply, solar, own generator, kerosene, other); H10 internet access by ADSL, fibre, satellite, fixed wireless, mobile; H11 waste disposal (public collection, dump, burn, compost, bury, sea); H12 disaster preparedness (food stock, know nearest evacuation centre and route, town officer, emergency contacts); H13 diet. Rows: Tonga, divisions, districts and villages.
